# CoSyER is a high-throughput data generation approach for environmental machine learning (Miller et al., ChemRxiv, 2026, https://chemrxiv.org/doi/full/10.26434/chemrxiv.15005434/v1)
#While this approach can be used for many hazard assessment, we herein used CAR receptor binding activity of organophosphate esters as the example for proof of concept
#A simple Random Forest model was used with a scaffold split strategy, while the same dataset can also be used to fine-tune deep learning models.
#Input data is the CAR.csv dataset generated by AS-MS, with 266 OPE compounds. As shown in the column 'Activity', 142 OPEs were defined as 'active' based on their AS-MS signals, while 124 OPEs were defined as 'inactive'.
